//: Gruvbox dark (github.com/morhetz/gruvbox) over a pixel-art alley at dusk.
//1: THE source for every shell surface (quickshell/: bar, launcher, OSD, power
//2: menu). The roles were transcribed from the @define-color block of the old
//3: waybar/style.css and from wofi/style.css — not invented; those stylesheets
//4: are gone and live only in git history. `tokens` keeps the gruvbox names
//5: so the lineage survives; `roles` is what QML actually reads. theme.lua
//6: still owns WINDOW chrome (gaps, border, blur, shadow); CI cross-checks it.
name: gruvbox
//tokens: gruvbox name -> role, so a palette bump stays traceable.
//effects: Matte CRT: no glow anywhere (the red alert pulse is the one exception, and it is hardcoded), scanlines ride every panel.
//bar: Bar identity. CRT terminal: near-sharp 4px corners, chunky 2px frame, no accent hairline.
//launcher: Launcher identity (was wofi/style.css): purple 2px frame, 4px everything — a TUI box.
//osd: OSD identity (was swayosd/style.css): a CRT indicator cell — near-sharp, chunky orange frame.
//session: Power-menu identity (was wlogout/style.css): 4px tiles, chunky 2px orange frame at 55%.
//wallpaper: Shared by hyprlock.conf (brightness) and sddm/Main.qml (1 - brightness scrim).
